compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: validate-review-output.sh accepts reviewer-findings.json with exactly two top-level keys (findings, summary) and rejects files containing a scores key

## What to modify
Update tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh to assert the new 2-key schema BEFORE validate-review-output.sh is updated:

**test-validate-review-output.sh changes:**
1. CHANGE the code-review-dispatch valid-schema test fixture from 3-key to 2-key:
   - Old: {"scores":{...},"findings":[...],"summary":"..."}
   - New: {"findings":[...],"summary":"..."}
   - Assertion: test_code_review_dispatch_valid_schema_valid_yes passes (exits 0, SCHEMA_VALID: yes)
2. ADD test_code_review_dispatch_with_scores_key_rejected: fixture with scores key present → SCHEMA_VALID: no
   Given: {"scores":{"hygiene":5,...},"findings":[],"summary":"..."}
   When: validate-review-output.sh code-review-dispatch <file> runs
   Then: exits non-zero, output contains SCHEMA_VALID: no
3. REMOVE the cross-validation tests that check scores-vs-severity consistency (lines ~290-360)
4. UPDATE all other code-review-dispatch test fixtures to use 2-key schema (remove scores from all fixtures in tests at lines ~214-350)
5. Update N/A scores test to be a 2-key fixture instead

## Given/When/Then
Given: A reviewer-findings.json with only {findings:[], summary:"All good"}
When: validate-review-output.sh code-review-dispatch <file> runs
Then: exits 0, output contains SCHEMA_VALID: yes

Given: A reviewer-findings.json with {scores:{hygiene:5,...},findings:[],summary:"..."}
When: validate-review-output.sh code-review-dispatch <file> runs
Then: exits non-zero, output contains SCHEMA_VALID: no

## RED markers required
.test-index entries:
- tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh [test_code_review_dispatch_with_scores_key_rejected]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] test_code_review_dispatch_with_scores_key_rejected exists
  Verify: grep -q 'test_code_review_dispatch_with_scores_key_rejected' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/hooks/test-validate-review-output.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for new test
  Verify: grep -q 'test_code_review_dispatch_with_scores_key_rejected' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
